title: Japanese Crispy Chicken Karaage
description: A classic Japanese dish, crispy fried chicken karaage is perfect for snacking or as a meal. This recipe uses a simple marinade and a light dusting of flour to achieve the perfect crunch.
instructions: 1. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and place in a large bowl.
2. In a blender or food processor, combine flour, garlic, and chili powder. Blend until smooth.
3. Pour the flour mixture over the chicken and toss to coat.
4. Heat about 1-inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
5. Add the coated chicken to the oil and fry until golden brown and crispy, about 5-7 minutes.
6. Remove the chicken from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
7. Serve hot and garnish with crumbly mozzarella cheese if desired.
